title: Analytics Consultant Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on analytics, statistics, SQL, business problem-solving, visualisation, consulting communication, stakeholder management, and turning data into actionable recommendations.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 build programming, statistics, SQL and business fundamentals; Years 3–4 add consulting-style problem solving, dashboards, experimentation, client communication, internships and end-to-end analytics projects.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from executing analyses to defining client problems, designing analytical approaches, managing stakeholders and translating evidence into business decisions. Develop a domain specialisation such as finance, healthcare, retail, technology or operations alongside technical analytics skills.
